images.name: team
images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Qubriant technology company website, team page hero image. Create a premium photorealistic architectural concept of a collaborative software design studio, NOT a real office documentary photo: a refined meeting table with several open laptops showing abstract blue UI shapes, notebooks and a few elegant office chairs, glass partition, soft greenery and distant tropical daylight through tall windows. No people. Calm confident atmosphere, realistic glass, brushed metal and wood, navy blue, white and restrained electric cyan accents to fit a white and blue software-company website. Landscape 3:2 image, central composition that also survives a square crop, beautiful depth, soft cinematic light. No words, no logos, no watermark, no readable interface text. Output one finished website image, not a collage.
